# Astronomical 0.2.52
## What's new
- **Qwen-Image-2.1 text-to-image generation** is served end to end. The model is discovered and verified from the installed artifact, built in the inference worker, dispatched through the supervisor image lane, and gated by the download-executable preflight. A curated entry is available for download in Observatory, then generated through the OpenAI-compatible image endpoint. - Supported envelope matches the verified artifact: 256–1024 px in multiples of 32, 1–40 steps, guidance exactly 1.0. - The pipeline builds per request and reloads weights between renders instead of holding ~10 GB wired idle.
## Compatibility
- Apple Silicon, macOS 14 (Sonoma) and later. - One local user and one active generation at a time. - No configuration or state migration; existing Stable state and Library downloads are preserved.
## Distribution
- Signed with a Developer ID Application identity, Hardened Runtime, and Apple notarization. - Distributed as a signed DMG and Sparkle update, both bound by SHA-256 digests in the release manifest.
